name: file.read
description: Read the contents of a file. Returns base64-encoded bytes or text depending on encoding. Read-only.

path.description: Absolute path. Windows accepts forward or back slashes; long paths via \\?\ on NT 5.1+.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from.

length.description: Maximum number of bytes to read. If omitted, reads to end of file.

content.description: Decoded text or base64-encoded bytes if encoding=binary.

windows-modern.description: CreateFileW + ReadFile. UTF-16 native, transcoded per encoding arg. Long paths via \\?\ prefix.

windows-classic.description: CreateFileA on NT 4 / 9x; CreateFileW on NT 5+. No long-path support pre-NT-5.1 — paths over MAX_PATH return ERR not_found.
